acceptance.explanation: The header and five audit rows bind the active specification; the closing snapshot separately records the run end.

components.name: context and memory
components.reason: The sitting keeps state and bounded prior turns. The Table persists latch and soft state; holds last this sitting only. There is no long-term conversation memory across sittings.

components.name: tool and action interfaces
components.reason: No model is given tools or actions. Adapters accept text and return text; replies are never executed.

components.name: sandboxing
components.reason: No agent-executed code exists. Model output is text only; there is no execution sandbox to claim.

components.name: execution runtime and lifecycle management
components.reason: The Table has sitting expiry, latch persistence, reload recovery, a response wait and model concurrency control. The harness has bounded retries and adapter transport timeouts. There is no durable full transcript checkpoint or resume of an interrupted model call. The plain harness relies on its caller for sitting expiry and concurrency control.
